fields.title: ANPI company directory record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Successful records (_source: S1-anpi-rest) are the exact JSON row ANPI's own REST API returns for a company, field names verbatim.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The search term you gave (if any), or a description of the island/year/city/sector/RCCM filters used, or "(all companies)" for an unfiltered browse.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: S1-anpi-rest (successful record from ANPI's own REST API), or none (error record).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed jobs -- no_results (filters/search matched nothing) or blocked_or_transient (network issue).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

_warning.title: Warning
_warning.description: pagination_truncated_by_page_cap if this job had more matches on file than this actor's safety page-depth cap allowed it to fetch.

rccm.title: RCCM number
rccm.description: Registre du Commerce et du Crédit Mobilier number on file. Empty for every record as of this actor's last verification -- an upstream data-entry gap, not a scraping gap (see README).

secteur.title: Business sector
secteur.description: Business sector code on file. Empty for every record as of this actor's last verification -- an upstream data-entry gap, not a scraping gap (see README).

annee.title: Registration year
annee.description: Year the company was registered/created, as recorded by ANPI.

siege.title: Headquarters
siege.description: Free-text registered headquarters address, as recorded by ANPI.

ville.title: City
ville.description: City on file. Empty for every record as of this actor's last verification -- an upstream data-entry gap, not a scraping gap (see README).

dirigeant.title: Manager/director
dirigeant.description: Name of the company's manager/director on file. Empty for every record as of this actor's last verification -- an upstream data-entry gap, not a scraping gap (see README).

capital.title: Share capital
capital.description: Declared share capital (in Comorian francs) on file. Empty for every record as of this actor's last verification -- an upstream data-entry gap, not a scraping gap (see README).

forme_juridique.title: Legal form
forme_juridique.description: Legal form code, e.g. SARL, SARLU, EI, SAS, PP.

description.title: Description
description.description: Free-text description of the company's activity, where present. Null for most/all records observed.

date_creation.title: Record created
date_creation.description: Timestamp this row was created in ANPI's own database (a data-entry/import timestamp, not the company's own registration date -- see 'annee' for that).

date_maj.title: Record last updated
date_maj.description: Timestamp this row was last updated in ANPI's own database.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns for every company record.
